other_numbers: old inventory book Nº 1: 138-143 (Área de Antropología) lists the 30 objects
object_title_original: cocodrilo nuevo momificado de la caverna de Maabda
object_title_english: young mummified crocodile from the Maabda cave
classification_basis: description in González et al. 2009: 'cría de cocodrilo momificado, completo, envuelto en un textil'; fig. caption 'corresponde a un cuerpo completo' (photo in article, not personally examined)
species_if_given: Crocodilus niloticus (stated by González et al. 2009)
provenance: 'caverna de Maabda' (El-Maabdeh, Middle Egypt) according to the museum inventory
description: Juvenile ('cría') crocodile mummy, complete, wrapped in textile; detail of skull shown in fig. 11 (photos 2007). X-rayed c. 2016 (MNHN news).
bibliography: González G., Valenzuela & Acevedo C. 2009, Boletín MNHN Chile 58: 105-120, pp. 111, 113, 115 (figs 11-12)
source_of_identification: Peer-reviewed museum bulletin article by MNHN curator and co-authors; confirmed by MNHN official news 2016
notes: MNHN news 2016-04-28 (https://www.mnhn.gob.cl/noticias/momias-egipcias-del-mnhn-una-ventana-directa-al-estudio-del-pasado): radiographs taken of 'una cría de cocodrilo momificada'. Results of X-ray not found.
